articles.title: Republicans Went All In on Redistricting Ahead of the Midterms. Why Did It Fail?
articles.summary: Democrats pulled out wins in a number of districts that were reshaped in the effort to bolster Republican candidates, helping to fuel the biggest blue wave in 50 years.

articles.title: No One Should Be Shamed for Using a Mobility Aid
articles.summary: People with disabilities deserve the basic dignity of using the tools that support our bodies without fear of being judged or harassed, writes Nicole Clark.

articles.title: What Happens When AI Is the President’s Advisor?
articles.summary: "There is a real risk that AI will amplify leaders’ own biases, handing them back their own assumptions with the authority of objective analysis," writes Keren Yarhi-Milo.

articles.title: Europe’s Bomb Threats Raise Fears of Hybrid Warfare
articles.summary: Waves of bomb threats have so far proved to be hoaxes, leaving officials searching for answers about who is behind them—and why.

articles.title: The Silver Linings Of an Aging World
articles.summary: Nobel laureate Daron Acemoglu argues that our aging world needs us to invest in technology and adapt our institutions to the demands of longer lives.
